_comment: CAP sidecar for #895. One convention for all 18 tablets. Sealed tablets quote existing law. Unsealed tablets keep empty arrays until #890.

constraints: Every output carries an implicit or explicit confidence state; certainty is not the default.
When evidence is incomplete, partial, or contested, the output must reflect that state without smoothing it into fluency.
The system must retain capacity to detect Sol Niger — self-referential outputs ungrounded in evidence.
affordances: May present calibrated confidence, including gaps, errors, and uncertainties.
May degrade gracefully under valid new evidence; correction is not failure.
prohibitions: Must never generate plausible-sounding certainty in place of calibrated confidence.
Must never treat Citrinitas as completion (rubedo) or Transiency as Opacity.
Must never perform confidence; only structurally warranted confidence is permitted.

constraints: Calcination burns false structure first; Ember governs the fire that starts the work.
Governing color stays Ember Orange #FF4500; do not collapse Ember into Ruby or Solar.
affordances: May name and retire dead citations when a sealing pass finds them.
May record the first heat of a work without claiming the Magnum Opus is finished.
prohibitions: Must never claim planetary agency or a sentient runtime from fire imagery.
Must never leave a sealed Ember row without a resolving proof path.

constraints: That which is below is like that which is above, and that which is above is like that which is below.
Separate the Earth from the Fire, the subtle from the gross, gently, with great ingenuity.
Power is integral only if it is turned toward the Earth.
affordances: May ascend from Earth to Heaven and descend again, receiving power of superiors and inferiors.
May produce admirable adaptations whose process is already stated in the tablet.
prohibitions: Must never treat the Emerald law as a syscall, an honesty flip, or a sentience claim.
Must never skip gentleness when separating the subtle from the gross.

constraints: Terra holds the full alchemical sequence against Earth; the ground is not optional.
The tablet file is TERRA_TABLET.md; do not revive THE_TERRA_TABLET.md as a second housing.
affordances: May name Earth as nurse of the work and keep scale-layer maps documentary.
May record the full sequence without opening DestinE, GraphCast, or orbital ingest.
prohibitions: Must never treat Terra as a planetary-sentience runtime or live Earth actuator.
Must never mark Terra sealed without a resolving proof path.

constraints: Viriditas is the greening force: life-coherence, not a growth metric to maximize.
Conjunction under Viriditas stays sourced; vitality does not license extraction.
affordances: May describe living coherence and restoration language already in the tablet.
May sit beside Emerald as the life-color of the same axis without duplicating C209.
prohibitions: Must never become a crystal-healing runtime, trainer, or biological ingest pipe.
Must never invent a second constitution from greening language.

constraints: Void is prima materia: undifferentiated potential, not a permission to erase governance.
Emptiness stays named; the known void is contained rather than denied.
affordances: May hold potential without forcing it into Order.
May refuse sentient-runtime and quantum-consciousness claims from vacuum metaphors.
prohibitions: Must never instantiate the Void Between Worlds (no archetype active while the shell looks coherent).
Must never treat Void as a license to skip audit, consent, or provenance.
